_doc: Rolling hours refresh, pulled from the place_hours_refresh table by npm run refresh:hours. Keyed by slug and bound by place_id to the canonical pre-business-status Google identity snapshot, which retains closed and off-season places so a later reopening can be discovered. Each entry overrides static enrichment hours and business status only while that identity still matches, with refreshed_at as the verification date the freshness policy reads. Written by scripts/pull-hours-refresh.mjs; do not edit by hand.
